title: Vice Salt Nic E-Liquid – Blue Razz Melon Ice 30ml
description:
Description
Introducing Blue Razz Melon Ice by Vice, a tantalizing E-liquid that combines the sweet and tangy flavors of blue raspberries and refreshing melons with a cool menthol twist. This exceptional blend will transport your taste buds to a world of icy fruit paradise.
With each inhale, you’ll experience the burst of juicy blue raspberries, delivering a delightful tanginess that awakens your senses. As the flavor unfolds, the luscious melon undertones emerge, adding a subtle sweetness that perfectly balances the tartness of the raspberries.
But what sets Blue Razz Melon Ice apart is the invigorating menthol sensation on the exhale. The icy coolness envelops your palate, providing a refreshing and revitalizing experience that leaves you feeling rejuvenated.
Crafted with care, Vice ensures that every puff delivers a smooth and satisfying throat hit. The high-quality ingredients and expert formulation guarantee a consistent and enjoyable vaping experience.
Whether you’re a fan of fruity blends or seeking a cooling sensation, Blue Razz Melon Ice by Vice is a must-try. Indulge in the harmonious fusion of blue raspberries, melons, and menthol, and let your taste buds revel in the sensational journey of flavors.
Flavour Notes:
Blue Raspberry
Melon
Ice
Vice Salt E-Liquid is NOT intended for use in Sub-Ohm Tank systems. Vice E-Liquid is intended for small pod systems.
50% VG 50% PG
